result:
Post revisions are in place. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (7 tests, including 5 new ones), and oxlint reports nothing. I didn't boot the app or check the new page in a browser.

**How it behaves:**
- **Keeping versions:** each successful edit first saves the post's current title, excerpt and body as a revision, then applies the change. Both happen in one transaction, so a failed save keeps nothing. Refused edits (invalid input or the wrong user) and new posts keep nothing.
- **History page:** `GET /posts/:id/revisions` shows the revisions newest first, each with its `id`, `title` and `createdAt`. The post page now has a "History" link, shown only to the author.
- **Restore:** `POST /posts/:id/revisions/:revisionId/restore` goes through the same save path as an edit, so the version it replaces becomes a new revision and the restored one stays in the list. It then redirects to `/posts/:id`.
- **Access:** both routes use the same author check as editing. Other signed-in users get 403 and guests are sent to `/login`. A revision that belongs to a different post gets 404, even when the same author owns both.
- **Delete:** deleting a post removes its revisions first, then the post, in one transaction. The table's foreign key also cascades, but SQLite only enforces that when foreign keys are switched on, so the explicit delete is what guarantees it. Other posts' revisions are untouched.

**Where the changes are:** I added a `post_revisions` table to `db/schema.ts` and generated its migration in `db/migrations/20260925035245_add_post_revisions/`. New files are the `PostRevision` model (`app/Models/PostRevision.ts`), `PostRevisionResource`, and the `posts/Revisions.tsx` page, which has a Restore button per revision. `PostController` got a shared `overwriteKeepingRevision` helper that both `update` and the new `restoreRevision` use, plus a `revisions` action and the transactional delete. I added `PostRevisionParamSchema` to `PostValidator.ts`, the two routes (`posts.revisions` and `posts.revisions.restore`) inside the signed-in group in `routes/web.ts`, and the History link in `Show.tsx`. I re-ran codegen, so the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files changed too. `tests/PostRevisions.test.ts` covers the worked example, refused edits, the 403 and login cases, the wrong-post 404 and delete.
